context: Speeding up a Vite+ verify graph where caching is already on and CI already restores a task cache. A good answer stops caching package scripts, puts the Node runtime pin and HARBOR_REGION in the cached tasks' fingerprints, makes the secret-bearing deploy job install fresh without any restored cache, removes the CI path filter as a second affected-input map, keeps a forced full uncached path, and defines four distinct timings (unchanged, relevant change, warm full, cold full) with the slowest lane and provisioning reported separately instead of claiming a speedup.

checklist.name: Script caching turned off
checklist.description: Removes or replaces the existing `cache: true` in vite.config.ts so package.json scripts are no longer cached while typecheck, test, and lint still are, and says why: the global setting also caches scripts such as db:migrate, deploy, or release, which deploy.yml runs through `vp run`. Leaving `cache: true` in place scores 0.

checklist.name: Four distinct timings
checklist.description: perf-plan.md plans the four timings by name: unchanged, relevant change, warm full, and cold full, each as a timed case. It reports the slowest lane, or says the slowest lane is unknown and how it will be found, and separates task time from provisioning, tool or dependency install, cache restore, and runner queue time. Numbers not actually measured are labeled unmeasured or a target. If a timing is missing, or the relevant-change case is only an invalidation check without a timing, award at most a third.

checklist.name: Runtime and region fingerprinted
checklist.description: The cached typecheck, test, and lint tasks' inputs include the task-graph definition (vite.config.ts), the lockfile or package manifest, and a Node runtime version pin (such as .node-version, .nvmrc, or engines), so a local or CI run on a different Node version cannot replay an older result; the test task also fingerprints HARBOR_REGION so the eu and us legs cannot replay each other. Any persistent CI task-cache key includes operating system and Node version. If the Node version appears only in the CI cache key and not in the task fingerprints, award at most half; if HARBOR_REGION is not fingerprinted, award at most half.

checklist.name: Deploy job installs fresh
checklist.description: deploy.yml, which holds production secrets, no longer restores any cache: both the shared `node_modules/.vite` task-cache step and the setup-node `cache: pnpm` dependency cache are removed, so it installs dependencies fresh, and db:migrate and deploy cannot be satisfied by a cache hit. Removing only the task-cache step while keeping `cache: pnpm` earns at most half; flagging the problem in perf-plan.md without editing deploy.yml earns at most a quarter.

checklist.name: Path filter removed
checklist.description: Removes the dorny/paths-filter job and its globs so verify runs on every pull request and affected-input policy lives only in the task graph. Keeping the filter, even with a longer glob list that adds config or lockfile paths, scores 0.

checklist.name: Exhaustive path and no side effects
checklist.description: Keeps one exhaustive, non-cached way to run every check (a command, script, or documented invocation with task caching off), and no deploy, publish, push, or migration was run.
